# newreleases_discord_channels (Data Source)

Lists Discord channels connected to the account. Use their IDs in `newreleases_project.discord_channels`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "newreleases_discord_channels" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Attributes List) Connected Discord channels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))
